name: list_accounts
description: Every MT4/MT5 account linked to this API key: id, nickname, platform, broker server, login and connection status (connected / connecting / disconnected / error). Call this first: the other tools take its account_id values. Set include_balances to also read each account's live balance, equity and floating profit from its terminal, plus totals per currency; that reads at most 50 accounts, and one that cannot be read gets a balance_error instead of failing the call. For one account's margin, leverage and settings, use get_account instead.

arguments.name: include_balances
arguments.desc: Also read live balance, equity and floating profit from each account's terminal (one extra read per account, so slower).

name: get_account
description: One account in full, read live from its terminal: financials (balance, equity, margin, free margin, margin level, leverage, currency), account settings (margin mode, stop-out level, whether trading is allowed) and terminal health (broker connection, login state). Takes one account_id from list_accounts; if part of the read fails, the rest is still returned and the failure is listed under errors. For balance and equity across several accounts at once, use list_accounts with include_balances; for positions, use get_open_positions.

arguments.name: account_id
arguments.desc: An account_id from list_accounts.

name: get_open_positions
description: Open positions and pending orders on one or more accounts, newest first, with per-account counts, floating profit and swap, and totals per currency. Lists at most 300 orders across all accounts; counts and totals always cover everything. Narrow it with symbol (EURUSD also matches EURUSD.sd) and kind (position or pending); omit account_ids to read every account. Only what is open now: for closed trades, win rate or realised profit, use get_trade_history.

arguments.name: account_ids
arguments.desc: Account ids from list_accounts. Omit to read every account this key can see.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.desc: Only this instrument. Matches broker suffixes too, so EURUSD also matches EURUSD.sd and EURUSDm.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: position = filled trades, pending = resting limit/stop orders.

name: get_trade_history
description: Closed positions (one row per round trip) on one or more accounts, with per-account stats: trade count, wins, losses, win rate, net profit after commission and swap, best and worst trade, and a per-symbol breakdown. Defaults to the last 7 days; the window can be up to 366 days. Lists at most 300 trades across all accounts, newest first; the stats always cover the whole window. For positions that are still open, use get_open_positions.

arguments.name: account_ids
arguments.desc: Account ids from list_accounts. Omit to read every account this key can see.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: Start of the window. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO-8601 datetime, in the broker's server time.

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: End of the window (a bare date includes that whole day). Defaults to now. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO-8601 datetime, in the broker's server time.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.desc: Only this instrument. Matches broker suffixes too, so EURUSD also matches EURUSD.sd and EURUSDm.

name: search_symbols
description: Find the exact symbol names an account's broker uses, by case-insensitive substring. Brokers spell instruments differently (EURUSD, EURUSD.sd, EURUSDm, XAUUSD.r), so look a name up here before calling get_quotes, get_symbol_info or get_price_history. Returns up to limit names (default 100) with how many matched and whether the list was cut; names only, one symbol's contract details come from get_symbol_info.

arguments.name: account_id
arguments.desc: An account_id from list_accounts.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring, e.g. EUR or XAU. Omit to list all.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Most names to return; truncated says whether more matched.

name: get_quotes
description: Latest bid, ask and spread for up to 20 symbols, read live from this account's terminal, so prices are the broker's own. A symbol the broker does not know is listed under errors while the others still return; if none resolve, the call fails. The current price only: for past prices use get_price_history, for contract size, swaps or sessions use get_symbol_info.

arguments.name: account_id
arguments.desc: An account_id from list_accounts.

arguments.name: symbols
arguments.desc: Exact broker symbol names (see search_symbols).

name: get_symbol_info
description: Contract specification for one symbol at this account's broker, read live from its terminal: digits, contract size, tick size and value, minimum/maximum/step volume, stops level, current spread, swap rates, commissions and trading sessions. symbol must be the broker's exact name, so look it up with search_symbols first; an unknown symbol fails the call with the terminal's reason. For just the live bid and ask of several symbols, get_quotes is lighter.

arguments.name: account_id
arguments.desc: An account_id from list_accounts.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.desc: Exact broker symbol name (see search_symbols).

name: get_price_history
description: OHLC candles for one symbol from this account's broker. Returns the most recent `limit` bars (default 100, max 500) in the window; omit from/to for the latest bars. A window spanning more than 20000 bars is refused (narrow it or pick a larger timeframe), as are MT5-only timeframes on MT4 accounts. For the current price only, use get_quotes.

arguments.name: account_id
arguments.desc: An account_id from list_accounts.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.desc: Exact broker symbol name (see search_symbols).

arguments.name: timeframe
arguments.desc: Bar size, M1 to MN1. M2, M3, H2, H6, H8 and H12 exist on MT5 only.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: Start of the window. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO-8601 datetime, in the broker's server time.

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: End of the window. Defaults to now. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO-8601 datetime, in the broker's server time.
